pick.name: Oracle Cloud Always Free (Ampere A1)
pick.what: Free ARM VM for Docker, Coolify, Uptime Kuma, self-hosted runners, cron
pick.why: Only meaningful always-free VM: 2 OCPU/12 GB A1 + 2 AMD micros + 200 GB disk + 10 TB egress
pick.free_limits: A1: 1,500 OCPU-h + 9,000 GB-h/mo = 2 OCPU/12 GB (doc today; older guides say 4/24); 2x E2.1.Micro 1 GB; 200 GB block; 10 TB/mo out; reclaimed if 95th-pct CPU, network and (A1) memory all <20% over 7 days; capacity often unavailable; card verification
pick.windows_fit: web console; SSH from Windows OpenSSH
pick.install: web (OCI console) then: curl -fsSL https://cdn.coollabs.io/coolify/install.sh | bash (Coolify, optional)

alts.name: Hetzner Cloud
alts.what: Cheap reliable VPS incl. Singapore region
alts.why: Best pay-later VM: predictable, no reclaim risk
alts.free_limits: No free tier; from EUR 5.99/mo (Cost-Optimized) / EUR 6.49 (Regular) excl. VAT per page today; DE/FI/SG/US

alts.name: Fly.io pay-as-you-go
alts.why: Cheapest always-on container if you only need 256 MB
alts.free_limits: No free tier for new orgs (2 h runtime or 7-day trial); shared-cpu-1x 256 MB $2.19/mo, 1 GB $6.70/mo; dedicated IPv4 $2/mo

candidates.name: Oracle Always Free
candidates.verdict: PICK: the only real always-free VM; accept reclaim/capacity risk

candidates.name: Hetzner Cloud
candidates.verdict: Alt: best paid value; first move when Oracle reclaims or capacity fails

candidates.name: Google Compute e2-micro free
candidates.verdict: Not verified this session; tiny (1 GB) and US-only per common knowledge

candidates.name: AWS Free Tier
candidates.verdict: Now credit-based ($200, used within 12 months) per AWS pricing pages; not always-free

candidates.name: Render/Koyeb free
candidates.verdict: Rejected: spin-down / free tier closed to new users

decision: Oracle is the only always-on VM at $0 with real capacity; keep anything on it reproducible (Docker Compose/Coolify) because Oracle can reclaim idle instances. Move to Hetzner (~EUR 6/mo) when you need guaranteed uptime for a paying customer.
details: Official doc now says A1 = 2 OCPU/12 GB, not the 4/24 quoted by older guides.

verify.note: Oracle doc: 1,500 OCPU-h + 9,000 GB-h = 2 OCPU/12 GB for Always Free tenancies; 2x E2.1.Micro; 200 GB block; 10 TB egress; idle = 95th-pct CPU <20%, network <20%, memory <20% (A1) over 7 days. All confirmed. commercial_ok stays unclear (oracle.com/cloud/free/faq returned 403).
